build.description: Compiles TypeScript source to dist/. Workspace dependency builds run first (^build).

test.description: Runs the test suite. Workspace dependency builds run first (^build) — required for packages that expose only dist/.

dev.description: Watches source for changes. Workspace dependency builds run first (^build). Persistent and never cached.

typecheck.description: Runs TypeScript compiler in noEmit mode to check for type errors. Workspace dependency builds run first (^build) so their emitted .d.ts files resolve.

clean.description: Removes build artifacts, coverage, and reports. Never cached.
